nom: SUNDAY RILEY Ceramic Slip Cleansing Gel

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/combination skin report the gel cleans effectively without over-drying, and one reviewer with oily skin uses it as a scalp wash with good results.
segments.dry: Reviewers describe dry or very dry skin say it does not strip or tighten, though a few with dry skin report it dried them out, caused breakouts, or overdried when used undiluted.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances oiliness and dryness better than foaming or cream cleansers they tried before, cleansing without stripping.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin say it is one of few cleansers that does not cause burning, tightness or redness, though one sensitive-skin reviewer felt it simply did nothing.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin report it cleanses without stripping moisture and one felt it helped maintain a youthful look, though one mature reviewer found it overdrying when used on wet skin over the whole face.
segments.normal: One reviewer without a stated concern found it a straightforward, effective daily cleanser.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature/aging skin report it cleanses gently without stripping and one credits it with a more youthful glow; no negative reports specific to aging skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report no dryness or tightness and several say it left skin refreshed and moisturized, but multiple others report it dried out their skin, caused tightness, or overdried when overused or applied to already very dry skin.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report redness calming down or fewer red blotches with regular use; no reviewer reports increased redness except one who described burning after a reported formula change.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with an eczema flare reports it cleansed without irritating the flare; another with very sensitive skin reports no effect either way.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fewer bumps, smaller pores, reduced blackheads or cleared forehead pimples with regular use; one dry-skin reviewer reports the opposite, that it caused breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report reduced acne scarring, glow, and no new breakouts in most cases; one reviewer explicitly declines to comment on acne efficacy since she is not acne-prone.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report it cleans without leaving a greasy residue and controls oil better than foaming cleansers they compared it to.

aspects.libelle: Fails to remove makeup or mascara

extraits.texte: I have dry, insanely sensitive skin. This did nothing for me. It did not hurt my skin, but it did not help either.

extraits.titre: Not great for my skin type, better for super-dry types
extraits.texte: I love Sunday Riley. I've never met a product of theirs that I didn't like... until this. As a cleanser, it did not effectively remove makeup or make my skin feel particularly clean. I even tried double-cleansing with this, and still my face felt filmy. I think it would work well for those who don't wear much sunscreen or makeup, whose skin is dry as the Sahara and too reactive for most cleansers, but for me, this was a huge waste. I sent it right back.

I have repurchased this for a second time. I have been on a cleanser hunt for years. It's really hard to find a combo of products that doesn't affect my skin as it has become sensitive. My skin will typically burn, get red, feel tight and extremely dry. This cleanser doesn't make my face feel that way. May not work for everyone of course, as everyone's skin is different. For the reviews that say it leaves makeup on- I wouldn't use this to remove makeup! I double cleanse with a cleansing balm and the original makeup eraser cloth (and I'll even follow up with micellar water from bioderma) and then cleanse with this face wash. I'm not acne prone (maybe just hormonal breakouts rarely) so I can't comment on it being good for that purpose. But this is a good gentle face wash!

Best cleanser out there!I have very sensitive/ acne prone skin and have tried many other cleansers, this one is by far my favorite. My pores look so much smaller, it doesn't over dry and it takes off my makeup! I highly recommend!

I have had the hardest time finger a wash for my combo skin. Foam dries me out. Cream makes me too oily. This was has the perfect mix of both. I use this and the ufo serum. I have struggled with breakouts since I was a teen and I have used legit everything under the sun from 15$-50$ price range for cleanser. I'm about to purchase my second bottle. It goes perfect with my Clarisonic. Buy it!

For maturing, combination skin, this is a must buy, but fair warning... you have to actually emulsify when using & be sure to remove makeup beforehand (I use a Makeup Eraser & a collagen milk tonic) because the surfactants aren't stupid hard core. As long as you take the time to really cleanse your face, you'll never regret using this, it's the only product that doesn't dry out my skin.
This face wash dried out my skin and caused breakouts. Returned it for a refund.
